note: Season 10 (1.1.3892207), updated for 1.1.3913745 and for the Oct 16 / Oct 22 2026 patches (1.1.3939753, 1.1.3962284); offsets are in the legacy .uexp from retoc-rivals-cli unpack (the assets in patched_sources come from the newest patch container that carries them, through a small carrier container, see ironman_beams.py). mi/lut/atlas/npci keep the file size; vm points colour operands of Niagara scripts at new literals appended to the script's literal table (the build fixes the export sizes). New colours are computed at build time from 'old' by recolor_lin, except entries with 'set'. Entries with 'old_hex' are checked against those exact bytes. An atlas entry with 'copy_of' writes the green version of another row (which stays vanilla because other effects read it) into a free row, and mi_scalars points the Iron Man only material at it.
